subject: Aligning contract sequencing and evaluation milestones for Securis POC
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Hayes <lauren.hayes@securishealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial MAP + proposed sequencing for POC (attached)

Hi Lauren —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Per our call I put together an initial mutual action plan (attached) that ties the evaluation milestones to the contracting steps so procurement has clear gating criteria for signatures. Highlights you should see in the MAP:

- Week 0: Data access and test account provisioning (internal Securis contact to confirm)
- Week 1–2: POC evaluation + performance measurements (we run 3 benchmark scenarios)
- Week 3: Security review and DPA checklist completion (legal to confirm required artifacts)
- Week 4: Order form finalization and commercial signoff

Two sequencing constraints we flagged:
1) We recommend signing the DPA in parallel with the MSA redline review so we don't block order form signatures on a separate path.
2) If procurement needs a signed MSA before any data access, we can provide a limited-scope evaluation dataset under a short-term NDA — we noted that as an option in the MAP.

Please review the attached "Securis_MAP_v2.xlsx" and call out any dates you need shifted. If procurement prefers, we can convert the MAP into a short mutual timeline for your purchasing system.

Next steps: can you confirm whether your procurement team requires the final MSA before test data provisioning? If they can accept the DPA first, we can keep the POC on the 4-week cadence.

Thanks,
Rishi
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Securis_MAP_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 3 tabs: milestones, owners, gating_criteria)

From: Lauren Hayes <lauren.hayes@securishealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@securishealth.com
Date: 2026-10-03T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP + proposed sequencing for POC (attached)

Rishi —

Thanks for the MAP and the clear breakdown. A few quick clarifications from procurement/legal:

- Our procurement team typically needs an executed MSA before we allow cross-environment data extracts. That said, for low-scope POCs they will sometimes accept a binding DPA + a scoped Order Form that limits data types.
- Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept our standard Addendum clause (we'll attach a short template) or whether you need to use your standard DPA?
- Estimated budget approvals are scheduled for 10/20; procurement would like any commercial commitments before that date.

Cc'd procurement@securishealth.com so they can weigh in on the MSA timing. If Redwood can run the POC with a DPA + limited Order Form, we can keep the evaluation on the 4-week timeline.

Appreciate the options — attaching our internal procurement checklist in a follow-up.

Best,
Lauren Hayes
Director, Product Ops
Securis Health

--- Original message attached below ---
On 2026-10-01 09:12, Rishi Malhotra wrote:
> Hi Lauren —
> 
> Thanks again for the time earlier. Per our call I put together an initial mutual action plan (attached) ...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-04T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Initial MAP + proposed sequencing for POC (attached)

Rishi / Grace —

Thanks — read through Lauren's note and procurement's preference (MSA first). Legal + I discussed and propose the following operational approach that minimizes blockers:

1) We push a limited-scope DPA (Redwood template) this week and ask Securis to confirm any Addendum clauses. If they insist on MSA first, ask procurement for a written exception to allow DPA-led provisioning.
2) Grace will prepare redlines to their requested Addendum and annotate risk items. I started a redline PDF (attached) with comments on data residency, audit logs retention, and subprocessors.
3) Commercial will prepare an Order Form draft with the POC SKU and an explicit termination/no-charge clause if metrics aren't met. That Order Form gets converted to a signed commercial attachment once legal signals green.

Timeline suggestion based on internal sequencing:
- 10/04: Submit DPA redlines to Securis (Grace) — ATTACHED: DPA_redlines_20261004.pdf
- 10/06: Securis responds on Addendum clauses / procurement exception request
- 10/08: Finalize Order Form draft (commercial) and share with Securis for review
- 10/12: Sign DPA + tentative Order Form (execute DocuSign)
- 10/20: Procurement budget approval window (Securis) — target to be fully signed before this date if possible

Marissa: please confirm you can produce the Order Form draft (I'll forward product SKU and pricing). Grace: flagged a question — do we need SOC-2 evidence earlier than the DPA signature? If so, we'll surface that in the DPA response.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: DPA_redlines_20261004.pdf (annotated redline, 12 comments)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Hayes <lauren.hayes@securishealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, procurement@securishealth.com
Date: 2026-10-05T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Initial MAP + proposed sequencing for POC (attached) — Consolidated plan + next steps

All —

Appreciate the quick back-and-forth. Per Marissa's suggestion and Grace's redlines, here's a consolidated operational plan we can share with procurement/legal at Securis today:

Operational commitments (short):
- We will deliver scoped data access within 48 hours of executing a mutual DPA (Redwood template with Securis Addendum flagged).
- We'll begin the POC benchmark run within 24 hours of data access. Benchmark tests are 3 pre-agreed scenarios; results shared in a single report.
- Order Form will include a 30-day evaluation SKU with no charge if performance thresholds are not met.

Proposed gating & dates (aligned for your 10/20 budget window):
- 10/05: Redwood sends DPA redlines (completed) + Order Form draft (attached)
- 10/06: Securis confirms Addendum exceptions / procurement exception request
- 10/08: Parties exchange final commercial terms
- 10/12: Target sign: DPA + Order Form (DocuSign link below)
- 10/20: Procurement budget approval — target full execution before this date

Links / artifacts:
- Order Form draft: OrderForm_draft.docx (attached)
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/RDW-4592
- Shared MAP folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAPs
- DocuSign (pre-fill): https://www.docusign.com/sign/abcde-2026-securis

Grace: please escalate any high-risk DPA clauses that would prevent us from provisioning. Marissa: confirm the POC SKU and I will push the draft Order Form live to the folder.

Lauren / procurement team: if anything here conflicts with your internal gating, call it out and we will adapt. Otherwise, we'll proceed with the DPA + Order Form path to keep the POC on the 4-week schedule.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: OrderForm_draft.docx (commercial draft), Securis_MAP_v2.xlsx (latest)
